name: Worldforged Treasure Seeking Lodestone's Ancient Elven Chest rests on the ground in Tanaris (#8691, #6061, #8421)
contract: The chest (gameobject entry 515800, guid 6942358) stood 4.01 yd under the sloped terrain at Lands' End beach: the realm-map pass moved it 23 yd to its map marker but kept the height it had at the old, flatter spot. The fix raises it to the ground so it can be seen and opened.
